title: Predictable generator use (csharp) — review required
description: Code in csharp draws from a non-cryptographic generator: news+Randoms*(s*). Output is predictable, so security values built on it can be guessed. This lexical rule flags the use; the reviewer confirms the value is non-security or switches to RandomNumberGenerator.
remediation: Draw security values from RandomNumberGenerator instead.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches the generator regardless of purpose. Argument-taking generator calls are separate rules.

tests.line: # audit: var r = new Random() present
